description: This file defines an abstract interface and concrete implementations of a notes management service, including local storage and API-based services, with methods for CRUD operations on notes, tags, and folders in a notes-taking application.

classes.name: NotesService
classes.description: Abstract class defining the interface for notes operations, to be implemented by concrete services for local storage or API communication.

classes.name: LocalStorageNotesService
classes.description: Concrete implementation of NotesService that stores data in browser's localStorage.

classes.name: ApiNotesService
classes.description: Concrete implementation of NotesService that communicates with a remote API backend.

methods.name: abstract listNotes(): Observable<Note[]>; listNotes
methods.description: Returns an observable emitting all notes ordered by last updated time descending.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Returns an observable emitting a single note by its ID.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note and returns an observable emitting the created note.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by ID and returns an observable emitting the updated note.

methods.name: listTags
methods.description: Returns an observable emitting all tags.

methods.name: upsertTag
methods.description: Creates or updates a tag with the specified name.

methods.name: listFolders
methods.description: Returns an observable emitting all folders.

methods.name: upsertFolder
methods.description: Creates or updates a folder with the specified name.

methods.name: moveToFolder
methods.description: Assigns or removes a note from a folder.

methods.name: toggleTag
methods.description: Assigns or removes a tag from a note.
